learning_actions.title: Data Structures Visualizer
learning_actions.description: 1. Choose a data structure (e.g., arrays, linked lists, trees). 2. Implement the chosen data structure in Python, ensuring to include methods for insertion, deletion, and traversal. 3. Create a visualization using Matplotlib to illustrate how the data structure changes with each operation. 4. Analyze the time complexity of each operation using Big O notation. 5. Document your findings and the code in a Jupyter notebook.
learning_actions.rationale: This project builds on your existing Python skills and introduces you to data structures, addressing the gap in your understanding of data structures and algorithms. The visualization component will also enhance your ability to communicate findings effectively.

phases.title: Exploratory Data Analysis and Visualization
phases.rationale: This phase builds on your existing skills in Python and Pandas, allowing you to deepen your understanding of data analysis and visualization. The projects will leverage your experience with Jupyter notebooks and will introduce you to data visualization techniques, which are crucial for a data scientist.

learning_actions.title: COVID-19 Data Analysis and Visualization
learning_actions.description: 1. Download the COVID-19 dataset from a public repository (e.g., Johns Hopkins University). 2. Use Pandas to load the dataset into a DataFrame and examine its structure. 3. Clean the data by handling missing values and filtering for relevant columns. 4. Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to summarize key statistics (e.g., total cases, deaths, recoveries). 5. Create visualizations using Matplotlib or Seaborn to show trends over time (e.g., daily cases, deaths by country). 6. Write a summary report in your Jupyter notebook detailing your findings and insights.
learning_actions.rationale: This project utilizes your existing skills in Python and Pandas while introducing you to data visualization techniques. It addresses your gap in data visualization and exploratory data analysis, which are essential for data scientists.
